name: stress-ng vecshuf
description: Start N workers that shuffle data on various 64 byte vectors comprised of 8, 16, 32, 64 and 128 bit unsigned integers. The integers are shuffled around the vector with 4 shuffle operations per loop, 65536 loops make up one bogo-op of shuffling. The data shuffling rates and shuffle operation rates are logged when using the -v option. This stressor exercises vector load, shuffle/permute, packing/unpacking and store operations. The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.duration: Duration (seconds) of the benchmarking framework run that produced this score, shared by all benchmarks and configs of that run.
